shipped_rule: thin dots, belief priority, 4% of the candidate area, min separation 3 px

catalogue_subsample_sweep.instrument: PROXY: truth = seeded 20% subsample of the visible catalogue

offcat_instrument.instrument: FAITHFUL: fault systems split A/B, trained on A, truth = B, official DTI
offcat_instrument.note: this is the instrument that decides; its per-fold rows are in evidence/offcat_holdout.json

decision: The coverage-lattice promotion was REFUTED by the faithful instrument (-0.0104 mean paired DTI, 1/4 folds at q0.10; +0.0040 but only 2/4 folds at q0.20). Under the pre-registered rule (mean > 0 AND >=3/4 folds positive) no lattice is promoted, so the incumbent thin-dot rule ships.
lesson: A promotion validated only against a subsample of the visible catalogue did not survive a holdout that withholds whole fault systems. This is exactly what the standing instruction to validate before spending a slot is for.
